en.title: Project Estimates
en.description:
Given distinct project costs and a target difference, count the distinct unordered pairs of values whose absolute difference is exactly target.

This site's input protocol and the explicitly stated supplementary ranges are compiled by CSWork and do not pose as the original OA rules.
en.input: The first line contains n target (1≤n≤200000, 1≤target≤10^9); the second line contains n distinct positive integer costs (≤2×10^9). Following the original examples, this site sets the lower bound of n to 1.
en.output: Output the number of unordered pairs of values whose absolute difference equals target.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Put the costs into a hash set; for each x, check whether x+target exists. Since target>0, each unordered pair is counted only once, from its smaller value.
